$comment: Golden template for a line-level BREAKPOINT snapshot (.NET). Body carries ONLY captures.lines.<line>.locals - no entry, no return, no duration-bearing exit block, because a line probe is a point observation. The line key is the source line number as a STRING (JSON object keys), which is why it is wildcarded here and asserted separately by the test that knows the resolved line. Not yet wired to a test: line-level coverage is deferred until PDB source-line resolution is exercised end-to-end in CI. The PDBs and the ProbeTargets.cs '@probe:' markers the tests will need are already staged, so wiring it up needs no new fixtures.
